people.name: Gideon
people.line: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.

people.name: Joash
people.line: The father of Gideon, a judge of Israel

translations.web: They said to one another, “Who has done this thing?” When they inquired and asked, they said, “Gideon the son of Joash has done this thing.”
translations.bsb: “Who did this?” they said to one another. And after they had investigated thoroughly, they were told, “Gideon son of Joash did it.”
translations.kjv: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.
translations.asv: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they inquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.
